title: crataegus monogyna var. eriocarpa
intro: Crataegus monogyna var. eriocarpa, commonly known as the White Hawthorn or Eriocarpa Hawthorn, is a variant of the Crataegus monogyna species, a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of White Hawthorn include vasodilation, anti-inflammatory effects, and antioxidant activity, which contribute to its cardiovascular and anti-aging benefits. The bioactive constituents of White Hawthorn include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
